# zoom_grid { #mofography.helper.zoom_grid }

`helper.zoom_grid(grid, zoom_factor)`

It takes a 2D array and a zoom factor, and returns a 2D array that is the original array zoomed by
the zoom factor

## Parameters

| Name          | Type   | Description                                                                                                                          | Default    |
|---------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `grid`        |        | the grid to be zoomed                                                                                                                | _required_ |
| `zoom_factor` |        | The zoom factor along the axes. If a float, zoom is the same for each axis. If an array, zoom should contain one value for each axis | _required_ |

## Returns

| Type   | Description   |
|--------|---------------|
|        | A dask array  |
